title: Cross-Area Transfer Learning for VLC-based Indoor Localization with a Transfer Efficiency Score
abstract: arXiv:2610.29638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indoor localization systems are critical for Industry-4.0 applications. Visible Light Communication (VLC)-based systems offer advantages such as immunity to electromagnetic interference, high accuracy, and energy efficiency, but their performance is hindered by environmental variability across deployment areas. This paper presents a transfer learning (TL) framework for VLC-based indoor localization that enhances cross-area robustness while reducing data requirements. Using real-world measurements from four distinct areas of a Bosch manufacturing facility, we show that fine-tuning a deep neural network (DNN) pre-trained on source area data with only 40% of target-area measurements recovers 97% of full-data performance, thereby reducing the amount of target data needed. We further introduce the Transfer Efficiency Score (TES), a composite metric that identifies the most effective source models for transfer without exhaustive evaluation. Gu

translated_title: 基于迁移效率评分的VLC室内定位跨区域迁移学习
translated_abstract: 室内定位系统对工业4.0应用至关重要。基于可见光通信（VLC）的系统具有抗电磁干扰、高精度和能效高等优势，但其性能受到部署区域之间环境差异的阻碍。本文提出了一种用于VLC室内定位的迁移学习（TL）框架，在降低数据需求的同时增强了跨区域鲁棒性。利用来自博世制造工厂四个不同区域的真实测量数据，我们表明，仅使用40%的目标区域测量数据对在源区域数据上预训练的深度神经网络（DNN）进行微调，即可恢复97%的全数据性能，从而减少了所需的目标数据量。我们进一步引入了迁移效率评分（TES），这是一种复合指标，无需穷举评估即可识别最有效的源模型进行迁移。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向VLC室内定位的跨区域迁移学习框架，仅用40%的目标区域数据微调预训练模型即可恢复97%的完整数据性能，并引入迁移效率评分（TES）指标，无需穷举评估即可识别最佳迁移源模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-area transfer learning framework for VLC-based indoor localization that recovers 97% of full-data performance using only 40% of target-area measurements, and introduces a Transfer Efficiency Score (TES) to identify the most effective source models without exhaustive evaluation.
